mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 5.0% signals labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1150) and consumer spending (RSAFS < 450,000) indicate weakening demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when both HOUST < 1150 and RSAFS < 450,000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 105.0 indicates manufacturing slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as output capacity declines.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 240.0 in the prior month signals accelerating inflation, prompting Fed tightening that causes negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Payrolls exceeding 140,000 support consumer spending growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as earnings expansion continues.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when PAYEMS > 140,000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing starts below 1150 and consumer spending below 450,000 indicate demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when both HOUST < 1150 and RSAFS < 450,000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 105.0 during manufacturing contraction triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as output declines.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
